gaps.title: External authority evidence is cryptographically non-self-issuable
gaps.close_criteria: A repository writer cannot manufacture accepted closure: every submission and decision is verified under a current, non-revoked, narrowly scoped Ed25519 key from an externally pinned trust registry; the pinned PEM is re-encoded and required to contain the id-Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo algorithm and a 32-byte public key; normalized SPKI reuse is forbidden across key IDs, identities, organizations and PEM encodings; issuer attestation.signed_at and reviewer signed_at are included in their canonical signature preimages, and every reviewer time must follow every submitted evidence attestation; duplicate JSON object members and silently normalized authority fields are rejected; candidate, claims, artifact digests, limitations, evidence-set digest and reviewed gaps are signed; key-type confusion, public-key aliases, signature-time mutation, pre-evidence review, parser differentials, issuer/reviewer aliases and synthetic physical evidence fail closed.

gaps.title: Only the latest pull-request or branch CI run retains execution custody
gaps.close_criteria: Workflow concurrency is keyed by pull-request number or branch identity with cancel-in-progress enabled, never by commit SHA; every canonical job independently checks out and verifies the exact SOURCE_HEAD_SHA; a new push cancels the previous run for that PR without weakening exact-head artifact identity or granting CI source-write authority.

gaps.title: External evidence filesystem reads and detached-signature writes are TOCTOU-safe
gaps.close_criteria: One top-level validation uses one immutable byte view keyed by normalized lexical absolute path; every existing scoped artifact or public-key input is pinned by a stable bounded regular-file descriptor at path selection, so replacement or symbolic-link retargeting before repeated reads or before the first later consumer cannot change bytes used by hashing, parsing, secret scanning, key normalization or signature verification; resolved targets must remain inside the custody root; detached signatures are created only as new mode-0600 regular files through directory-descriptor traversal that rejects symbolic-link directory components and uses no-follow plus exclusive-create semantics; existing files, dangling links, output redirects, partial writes, unsupported secure directory APIs and overwrite attempts fail closed and have hostile deterministic tests.
